apparent_power.docs:
Use the apparent power value of the sensor in volt amps. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [HLW8032 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hlw8032#configuration-variables)*

current.docs:
Use the current value of the sensor in amperes. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [HLW8032 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hlw8032#configuration-variables)*

current_resistor.docs:
**float**: The value of the shunt resistor for current measurement. Default value is `0.001 ohm`.

*See also: [HLW8032 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hlw8032#configuration-variables)*

power.docs:
Use the (active) power value of the sensor in watts. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [HLW8032 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hlw8032#configuration-variables)*

power_factor.docs:
Use the power factor value of the sensor. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [HLW8032 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hlw8032#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) if you want to use multiple UART buses.

*See also: [HLW8032 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hlw8032#configuration-variables)*

voltage.docs:
Use the voltage value of the sensor in V (RMS). All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [HLW8032 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hlw8032#configuration-variables)*

voltage_divider.docs:
**float**: The value of the voltage divider on the board as `R_upstream / (R_downstream * 1000)`. Default value is `1.72`.

*See also: [HLW8032 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hlw8032#configuration-variables)*
